name: UI：视频上传节点-边界值验证(空商品ID/空视频URL/上传类型切换)
description: 验证视频上传节点的输入校验：商品ID为空时保存、视频URL为空时保存、上传类型切换

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).filter(el => el.textContent.trim() === '打开'); if(btns.length > 0) { btns[0].click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no open btn'; })()

return (() => { const modals = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal'); for (const m of modals) { if (m.classList.contains('ant-modal-hidden')) continue; const r = m.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width < 200) continue; const cards = m.querySelectorAll('.ant-card-hoverable, .ant-card'); for (const card of cards) { const t = card.querySelector('.ant-card-meta-title'); if (t && t.textContent.trim() === '视频上传') { card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); card.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

steps.description: 等待视频上传编辑抽屉加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const titleItem = formItems.find(i => (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').includes('标题')); if (!titleItem) return { open: true, noTitleField: true }; const titleInput = titleItem.querySelector('input, textarea'); if (!titleInput) return { open: true, noTitleInput: true }; const maxLen = titleInput.getAttribute('maxlength'); return { open: true, titleMaxLength: maxLen ? parseInt(maxLen) : null, titleTagName: titleInput.tagName }; })()
steps.description: 检查商品ID字段是否为必填

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const videoItem = formItems.find(i => { const label = (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''); return label.includes('视频') && !label.includes('上传'); }); if (!videoItem) return { noVideoField: true }; const videoInput = videoItem.querySelector('input, textarea'); if (!videoInput) return { noVideoInput: true }; const placeholder = videoInput.getAttribute('placeholder') || ''; return { videoPlaceholder: placeholder, videoTagName: videoInput.tagName }; })()
return (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden) .ant-drawer-close'); if(c) c.click(); return 'closed'; })()

_testDesign.realDomNotes: 视频上传节点字段: 上传类型(Select)/商品ID(Input)/视频(Input)；无标题/文案/达人账号字段
riskPoints: 商品ID为空时保存是否报错
视频URL为空时保存是否报错
上传类型切换是否影响其他字段显隐
